snippet.title: Mega Man DXtreme - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Mega Man DXtreme is a revamp of Mega Man Xtreme originally released on the Gameboy Color, developed by CX2 Team, with a re-imagined story, improved controls, wider screen, reworked weapons and bosses, and lots more ~

Download the full game right now on itch.io! 
https://tomycase.itch.io/megaman-dxtreme

Want to share your impressions or report a bug? Join our discord!
https://discord.gg/XCK5abq
